simple_line_graph.note: The line graph of a finite simple graph: one vertex per edge, as the subtype {e : {set G} | e \in E(G)} of endpoint sets, two edges adjacent iff distinct and sharing an endpoint; isolated vertices disappear, K2 gives one vertex, the triangle and the claw both give K3 (not injective), iterable as sgraph -> sgraph, functorial on isomorphisms. Neither the multigraph GTBase.base.line_graph nor the directed upstream mgraph.line_graph.
